summary: The audit checks the 22 units of formal coursework, each course letter graded when that option is offered: a lab course, two quantitative courses, 12 units of biology or technical electives (any BIOE lecture or lab course numbered 200 or above also counts, with at most one ethics course), and the seminar courses. It also counts 135 graduate units. The 3.0 GPA, the research advisor by the end of the fourth quarter, two TA assignments, the qualifying exam, candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation are checked by hand.

SJqbJrSG.why: Grading: "Any course that satisfies the PhD degree requirements must be taken for a letter grade if offered." "Select three or more Biology & Technical electives from the pre-approved list of 200+ Technical Elective courses" (heading: minimum 12 units). "All lecture and lab-based BioE courses at the 200+ level and above are considered Technical Electives. Directed research units (e.g., BIOE 391, BIOE 392) and BIOE 296 do not count ... One of these courses may be an ethics course from among BIOE 131, BIOE 177, CS152, CS182, CS184, CS256, CS278, or CS281." Counted as 12 units: no eligible course carries more than 5 units, so 12 units always takes three or more courses. Seminars, colloquia, research, teaching practicum and thesis units stay out of the BIOE pool.
